name: Northern Lights
desc: Animated aurora borealis with multiple colors
code: const aw=ctx.w||w; const ah=ctx.h||h; const colors=['#00FF88','#7DF9FF','#DA70D6','#00CED1','#FF69B4','#FFD700']; for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ const ax=aw*(0.05+i*0.16); const ay=ah*0.06+Math.sin(mt*0.5+i*0.8)*ah*0.05; const aop=0.05+Math.sin(mt*0.6+i*0.97)*0.04; svg += `<ellipse cx="${ax}" cy="${ay}" rx="${aw*0.18}" ry="${ah*0.15+Math.sin(mt*0.4+i*1.1)*ah*0.05}" fill="${colors[i%colors.length]}" opacity="${aop}"/>`; } for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ const cy=ah*0.08+i*ah*0.03; const sway=Math.sin(mt*0.7+i*1.3)*aw*0.06; const cop=0.06+Math.sin(mt*0.5+i*0.8)*0.04; svg += `<path d="M0 ${cy} Q${aw*0.2+sway} ${cy-10} ${aw*0.4} ${cy+4} T${aw*0.7} ${cy-6} T${aw} ${cy}" fill="none" stroke="${colors[i%colors.length]}" stroke-width="${3+Math.sin(mt*0.3+i)*1}" opacity="${cop}"/>`; } return svg;
